meta.name: arize-trace
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when downloading, exporting, or inspecting Arize traces and spans, or when a user wants to look at what their LLM app is doing using existing trace data, or when an already-instrumented app has a bug or error to investigate. Use for debugging unknown runtime issues, failures, and behavior regressions. Covers exporting traces by ID, spans by ID, sessions by ID, and root-cause investigation with the ax CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 下载、导出并检查 LLM 应用的追踪数据，快速定位运行时问题。
copy.tagline_en: Download, export, and inspect LLM app traces to quickly diagnose runtime issues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Arize to trace LLM apps and need to drill into traces and spans for root cause analysis.

howto.what: Claude 可以运行 ax 命令导出 Arize 的 trace、span 或 session 数据，并分析其中错误和性能问题。
howto.when: 当你需要查看或下载 Arize 中的 LLM 应用追踪数据，或者调试运行时错误、故障时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 trace ID abc123 的错误原因。
导出一份最近一天有错误的 span。
say.note: Claude 会使用过滤器导出错误 span 并展示结果。

say.text: 看看这个 session 的完整调用链。

howto.what_en: Claude can run ax commands to export Arize traces, spans, or sessions, and analyze errors or performance issues from the data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to view or download Arize tracing data, or debug runtime errors and failures in your LLM app.

say_en.text: Help me debug trace ID abc123.
say_en.note: Claude exports all spans for that trace and analyzes errors.

say_en.text: Export error spans from the last day.
say_en.note: Claude filters and exports error spans, then shows results.

say_en.text: Show me the full call chain for this session.
say_en.note: Claude uses session ID to export related traces.
